title: Observational Study for Patients With Hemoglobinopathies and Rare Inherited Anemia and Covid 19
official: Observational Study Multicentric Phamacological no Profit for the Treatment of Patients With Hemoglobinopathies and Rare Inherited Anemia Affected by Covid 19
criteria:
INCLUSION CRITERIA:

* Patients with an established diagnosis of thalassemia, sickle cell disease, other haemoglobinopathies and Rare Anemia inherit with a virological diagnosis of SARS-COV-2 infection.

EXCLUSION CRITERIA:

* nobody
